intro.line: Radio check. If you can hear me, you still owe me for the headphones.
Loud and clear, Opal. Put it on my tab.
The head in that deck came out of those ruins. Sold as-is. No refunds.
Bottom floor, biggest score, back by dinner. Easy money.

outro.line: Opal. There were two of me in there.
Mm. Did either of you find anything worth selling?

firstDeath.line: That one got me. Properly got me. And I'm back at the door.
Mm. It does that. Try not to make a habit of it.

idle.line: I'm billing you for this radio time.

intro.line: One floor down and the price of that deck just went up.
You already sold it to me.
I sold you a Walkman. You're wearing a miracle. Different shelf.

outro.line: Good crew. One quick, one patient, both gorgeous.
Crew. You've never split a take in your life.
Still haven't.

idle.line: Somebody carved every inch of this wall. Nobody signed it.

intro.line: This place really wants me to be in two spots at once.
Most people bring a partner for that.
I did. She's great. Little bossy.

outro.line: Take One stood there the whole time and didn't complain once.
...Which is weird, because I would have.

idle.line: You've gone quiet. Either you're thinking or you're dead.

intro.line: Licensed survey, Tolliver Vance. You're not on my site list.
I'm not on anybody's list. That's the appeal.
This floor needs four people. My four went home. Sensibly.
I brought four.
...I count one.

outro.line: That was all you. That was four of all you.
Write it up however you like, Tolly.
It's Tolliver. And I don't have a form for this.

idle.line: Take your time! I'm only timing you for the report.

intro.line: You're about to lose me. The rock gets thick from here down.
Finally. Some quiet.
Don't sell anything without me. And don't you d--
...Opal?
Huh. Just us, then.

outro.line: Turns out I talk a lot when nobody's listening.
Take Three thought it was funny, though. I could tell.

idle.line: Opal would have said something rude by now.

intro.line: You again! Mind the next room. It's very pointed at people.
How pointed?
I've stopped counting the holes in my survey flag.
Stay back here, Tolly. Some of me are about to get shot at.

outro.line: You sent yourself out as bait. Twice.
She volunteered.
I'd offer to come along. You seem... staffed.

intro.line: Headphones keep picking something up. It isn't Opal.
Moxie. Take one. Kept.
...Nope. Didn't hear that.

outro.line: She skipped, she ran, she made it. I'd have waited. Probably.

intro.line: Scavenger. One recording head. Four tracks. All kept.
Okay, headphones. Who is that.
I keep what this place records. You are keeping me busy.
You're welcome. I'm very watchable.

outro.line: "Easy money." Floor one. Kept.
Don't quote me to me.

intro.line: Hey. Voice. What's at the bottom? Rumour says time machine.
The master deck. It does not replay. It records over.
So it's real. Opal owes me a drink.
Opal. Three takes. Kept. The fourth was never recorded.
...She's been down here?

outro.line: All that 'sold as-is'. She knew exactly what it does.
She turned back at three. I've got four.

intro.line: Okay, team meeting. One, you're reckless. Two, you're late.
Three, you were perfect. Don't let it go to your head.
You are speaking to recordings.
Best crew I ever had. Nobody argues about the split.

outro.line: The next door is mine. The rooms rewind. I do not.
So you'll remember me. Good. Most people do.

idle.line: Four, you've been very quiet. I'm watching you, Four.

intro.line: Everything you commit, I keep. Everything I keep, I have read.
"Back by dinner." Floor one. Kept.
Then I'll have to be somebody you haven't filed yet.

outro.line: Four takes. None of them the one I expected. All kept.
It records over, Moxie. Go and look. Then decide what I lose.

firstDeath.line: That step is from take one. I was already waiting in it.

idle.line: I can wait. It is most of what I do.

intro.line: That's it? It's a tape deck. A very big tape deck.
One reel. Every beat this place has kept. Wind it back and the rest is gone.
Any beat. I could fix the haircut. The red bike. That one night.
...First things first. This room wants four of me.

outro.line: Listen to that. All four of us. Nobody cut.

firstDeath.line: Okay. That killed me. And I'm fine. Not thrilled. Fine.

firstGhostTake.line: Huh. See-through. Well, I'm here now.

firstDesync.line: She's skipping. Like a scratched record.
Catch up, you. We rehearsed this.

firstResetAll.line: Whole tape, gone. Fine. They were all rehearsals anyway.

firstLoot.line: First find. Opal will say twenty. It's worth sixty.

countIn.line: Quiet in the booth. That means you, Two.

takeCommitted.line: Lock it. She's on the crew.
Nobody touch it. It's perfect. Ish.

retry.line: Cut. I can do that prettier.

resetAll.line: Wasn't you, team. Was me. Was all of us.

death.line: Meant to do that. For the next me.

ghostTake.line: Tape's still rolling. So am I.
Dead on tape. Still on the clock.

rescue.line: Got you. You owe me. I owe me.
She lives! Told you I'm good company.

desync.line: That wall wasn't there last take.

resync.line: Welcome back. You missed a lot.

fail.line: Close. Not close enough to brag about.
The plan's good. The plan's fine. New plan.

lastTape.line: Four, you're up. No pressure. All the pressure.

win.line: Play it back. I want to watch.

loot.line: This one goes on me, not on the shelf.

bossRecall.line: Old trick. It kept the receipt.

ending.line: Choose your beat. I will not remember being asked.
Every take I wanted to cut was holding a door for the next one.
So don't rewind. Record. All four of me, one tape.
...Nobody has asked it to keep anything in a long time.
And Opal's three. Those are coming up with me.
--oxie? Eleven hours of static. Well? Did you find it?
Found it. Bolted to the planet. Wouldn't sell it anyway.
So you came up with nothing.
I came up with a mixtape. And this. It has your name on it.
...Three tracks. I never did the fourth.
I know. I played it. Hope you don't mind the company.
Not for sale. Put the kettle on. I'll play you both.

stinger.line: I've drafted a form for you. It has four signature lines.
